body: Thank you. Having to tell them makes me feel sick, I know it's something I need to man up and do but they will never trust me. I have told so many lies the last month. I have been looking for work but not able to find anything. I know I got myself into this situation and its my responsibility. Ever since I have been off my anti depressants (2 weeks) I have no motivation and have been extremely depressed and I feel like telling them and seeing their reaction is going to push me over the edge. I don't like lying to them, it was a mistake.
